Archive Submissions As JSON.description: Uploads the incoming records as a dated JSON blob, creating the container if needed.

Upload CSV Export.description: Uploads a CSV string (e.g. a monthly indicator export) and overwrites any previous file.

Upload To A Specific Container.description: Uploads a blob to a container other than the one set in the credential.

Upload One Blob Per Record.description: Loops over records and writes each one to its own blob.

Download JSON Lookup Table.description: Downloads a JSON blob (e.g. a facility code mapping) and parses it.

Download File As Text.description: Downloads a blob, such as a CSV dropped by a partner, as a string.

Get Blob Properties.description: Reads a blob's metadata, such as size and last-modified time, without downloading it.
